name: Matcha Sifter
summary: Fine mesh sifter for breaking up clumps before whisking. The difference between a smooth and a lumpy bowl.
description:
A fine mesh sifter used to break up clumps before whisking. Because matcha is naturally prone to compacting, sifting helps create a smoother mixture and more even foam.

Place the desired amount of tea into the sifter and press it through with the bamboo scoop or a small spoon before adding water. This small step noticeably improves texture and consistency.

Simple but worthwhile, especially for those preparing matcha regularly.
